role: コウモリの翼 (back). One purple bat wing seen from the side, rooted behind the shoulder (the pivot is near its lower right) and spread up and back to the left; it peeks out behind the helmet. Swings ±6° around the root every 1.4 s.

source.description: pixel art game item: a pair of small dark purple bat wings seen from the side, worn on the back of a character facing right, the wings spread up and back toward the left, the wing root at the lower right, membrane with finger bones, dark outline

note: Trimmed (25x25) and mirrored left-right (the generated wing grew up and to the right). Alpha is 0/255 only; 48 colors. The user picked the lighter purple so it shows on dark backgrounds.
